long_biography.plain_text:
By 2013, Andrade sat on the board of Andrade Gutierrez and held an executive role at Administradora Santo Estevão. At SolarGrid, he helped establish a distributed-solar business as Brazil's market was beginning to expand. He became an early shareholder and director, and represented SolarGrid on ABSOLAR's regional council.

SolarGrid evolved from rooftop installations into a developer, builder and operator of distributed-generation solar farms. The company entered capital markets, built more than 70 plants and served thousands of customers across several Brazilian states. Andrade remained a shareholder of the project-holding company in 2025, continuing his ownership and governance role.
